raw.details:
Overview:

  • Dates: 31st Oct & 1st Nov, 2026
  • Registrations: Now Open
  • Kickoff Session: 31st Oct (Saturday), 2026

This is a hands-on, build-first hackathon created for individuals who want to launch a real AI product, not just present ideas or mockups.

What You’ll Do:

During these two days, participants will:

  • Conceptualize, build, and launch a complete agentic AI solution
  • Work on practical, real-world challenges
  • Go through the entire product journey:
    • Identifying the problem
    • Designing system architecture
    • Integrating tools and APIs
    • Delivering a functional end product

The core focus is on building AI agents ready for real-world use that can:

  • Think and make decisions.
  • Interact with tools.
  • Execute tasks independently.

By the end, you’ll walk away with a working AI product that can be:

  • Added to your portfolio.
  • Demonstrated in interviews.
  • Expanded into real-world use cases.

Participation Guidelines:

  • You can join individually or in teams (up to 2 members recommended).
  • All development must happen within the hackathon timeframe.
  • You are free to use AI tools, APIs, and frameworks.
  • Participants must clearly document their process (problem → solution → architecture).
  • A functional prototype or live demo is required.

Submission Requirements:

  • A demo video or live working product.
  • Access to the codebase (GitHub or equivalent).
  • A brief explanation of your solution.

Rules & Evaluation:

️ Rules:

  • Fully pre-built solutions are not allowed (starter templates are acceptable).
  • Any form of copying or plagiarism will result in disqualification.
  • Teams must clearly specify their actual contribution vs AI-generated output.
  • Submissions must be fully working products, not just designs or presentations.
  • All entries must be submitted before the deadline.

Click here to join the WhatsApp Group for more details: https://chat.whatsapp.com/IhNciO5SvpHKVqMIJQfKAn?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4&iam=2
